folders.tables: docs/experiments/phd/main_trainerr_v1/addendum4/tables (order 9 tables/addendum4/ kept inside addendum4/ by order 1.1)

inherits.rule: order 1.7: places, controls, common definitions (column patch, target plane, outward normal, area, front/back, events, completeness) are those of addendum3.json places/common unchanged

fork.name: GeoGS-conf-guided-v1-r31
fork.parent: GeoGS-conf-guided-v1-r30 committed files (118), byte copy checked by sha256 (ALL_EQUAL)

switches.--jbgs_a4_grad_signed: off (default) | on: r28 gradient record also stores signed dL/dxyz (3) and signed dL/d opacity logit per term
switches.--jbgs_a4_stop_at: -1 (default) | N: leave the loop after iteration N records; --iterations unchanged (schedules unchanged)
switches.--jbgs_a4_occl_mask_m: -1 (default) | M: depth weight 0 where image depth finite>0 and image depth < target - M (sa-2, M=10)
switches.--jbgs_a4_mvs_dir: image depth folder for the mask (STAGE0 s61 <site>/maps/mvs)

unit_check.replay: te_replay deterministic 300-iteration real-state replay (probe r28off_a it 200, R1rep x ALS): /source=r30 vs /source=r31 byte-equal in every part
unit_check.functions: stop_now never true and apply_occl_mask returns without touching maps when defaults / args missing
unit_check.diff: r31 vs r30 differs only in train.py, jbgs_trainlog.py and new jbgs_a4.py
unit_check.sa1: with records added: 6000 counts (Gaussians, region bound/released/background) and curve losses beside the record run; r28 magnitude fields = |signed vector| (float32 tolerance 1e-5 relative)

sa1.base: TRAINERR tl_R1_ALS_own command (r28) unchanged with fork r31
sa1.region: TRAINERR region/R1rep_b10__ALS.json (same voxel range as the record run)
sa1.record: states and gradients every 20 to 1000, every 100 to 6000; scene dumps 0,1000,3000_pre_reset,3000,3500,5000,6000

sa2.base: addendum3 a3_train.py tl_B0_b10_LoD2_s0 command (TRAINLOG case config, trainlog on), fork r31
sa2.image_depth: finite and > 0 (addendum2 class rule, no confidence filter)
sa2.masked_share: per place: masked target pixels / target pixels of the place column patches over all training views

sa3.rule: order 8 sa-3; input build rule fixed in configs/phd/main_trainerr_v1/addendum4_sa3.json before the build (or the closest method in issues.md); not trained when not buildable within half a day

work_sa.gpu_rule: start on a GPU with >= 14 GiB free memory, at most one addendum-4 training per GPU, other jobs never stopped

places: annex_box (B0 x ALS, addendum3 ba3 record)
edge_floater (B173 x ALS, TRAINLOG tl_B173nb_b10_ALS_s0 attempt2 scene states)
work_ga.controls: addendum3 controls (floor/edge: record-region control points; annex: GT points of the B0 ALS scene inside the record region outside the annex box; floater: addendum3 work_ma control faces)
work_ga.code_check: file:line table only (2.1), files copied into the bundle
event_values: normal and tangent distance to the original target plane at the event (outward +)
self (init_id seed, born_how 0/1 at uid 0..n0) or child (split/clone)
fate at the last saved state (alive / deleted / rebound; distance when alive)
work_ga.gradient_sign: outward normal of the column target plane (addendum3 common.outward_normal); value = -dL/dxyz . n (the step direction of gradient descent along n; + = moved outward/towards camera) and raw dL/dxyz . n both written
work_ga.released_split: Gaussians released at any time up to 6000 vs bound at every recorded iteration until 6000

work_na.groups: bound to the place patches at 3000_pre_reset; survived = present at the 5900..6000 states (last record before 6000 reset: 6000_pre_reset if present else 5900), deleted = absent
work_na.occlusion: per Gaussian and training view whose image contains its centre: accumulated opacity of the rendered splats in front of the Gaussian centre depth along the centre pixel ray (2DGS torch compositing of addendum3 work na); median over views; states 3000_pre_reset and 3500
work_na.colour_weight: sum over the pixels of the views of alpha*T of that Gaussian (centre-pixel 9x9 window, 3000_pre_reset)
work_na.views: training views whose image contains the centre (in front of the camera)
work_na.front_kind: weight of the splats in front by kind (same patch, other patch, released, background)
work_na.gradient: sa-1 signed opacity-logit gradients by term, every 100 from 3000 to 6000; B0: addendum3 record-run states only (no signed gradients -> sign not available; magnitude only)

wrong_points.annex: 30000 mesh vertices in the annex box farther than 1 m from GT
wrong_points.south_wall: vertices behind the south wall face by more than 0.64 m

edge_occlusion.photos: two views with largest and two with smallest median (target - image depth)

work_ra.view_rule: three training views with the point in front of the camera, inside the image and least occluded (smallest |rendered depth - point depth|)
work_ra.history: record runs where they exist (B0 LoD2 TRAINLOG, R1 ALS TRAINERR); else not available

work_ma.lost: addendum2 work-ra lost points (own) of the scene

work_ba.photo_only_2dgs: FINALTRAIN/AXES71 photo-only 2DGS mesh of the scene (as in earlier figures)

reading_appendix: order appendix (analysis session); not used to choose or stop anything here
